messages:
incident-bot: Alert: Multiple GPU nodes in ap-southeast-1 breaching mem_pressure and ECC spike thresholds. Severity: P2. Paging oncall.

tom: acknowledged. joining. Quick check: are customers seeing failures or slowdowns?

leah: monitoring shows a burst of OOM-kills for small realtime pods and an associated uptick in 503s from the inference gateway between 02:13 and 02:19 UTC. Error rate peaked at ~0.9% for that region.

sre_manager: ok. Start live mitigation: (1) pause non-critical batch jobs in ap-southeast-1; (2) cordon and gracefully drain the hottest node (node-gpu-07) to stop ECC increases; (3) open a maintenance marker in PagerDuty for the flood of duplicate alerts.

leah: executing pause: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/batch-encoder -n workloads` — batch jobs going down.

carla: draining node now: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-07 && kubectl drain node-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` 

ops_bot: Autoscaler notice: scale-down delayed due to pods with local-storage. Current pool size unchanged.

tom: noticed GPU temps on node-gpu-07 hit 85C briefly before drain; VRAM used 98% on pmap. Might be a colocated training job that slipped past scheduling constraints.

leah: logs show repeated ECC single-bit corrections on node-gpu-03 as well. Those were noisy but didn't cause OOMs. We were getting 1-2 corrections/min which triggered the page.

sre_manager: immediate suppression: adding a 12m grouping suppression in PD for device_ecc_events to avoid page storms while we stabilize. Keep the alert as a single digest.

carla: hardware note — node-gpu-07 had an /var/log/syslog entry showing NVML reports of correctable errors and then an increase in PCIe resets. Ill flag a hardware RMA.

leah: proposing we change the Prometheus rule that currently pages on any ECC delta within 1m. Current rule:

```yaml
alert: GPU_ECC_Spike
expr: increase(device_ecc_total[1m]) > 0
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  description: "Any ECC events on GPU"
```

leah: my proposed replacement (decrease noise, surface true regressions):

```yaml
alert: GPU_ECC_Sustained
expr: increase(device_ecc_total[10m]) >= 5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  description: "Sustained ECC events on GPU node - investigate hardware"
```

leah: escalate to page only if `increase(device_ecc_total[30m]) >= 20` or if ECC coincides with `gpu_vram_pressure > 95` for >2m.

tom: also add a cooldown label so we dont page the same node repeatedly during maintenance windows.

sre_manager: agreed. Also tune the VRAM pressure alert. Current mem pressure alert is very reactive and triggers on short spikes. New suggestion:

```yaml
expr: avg_over_time(gpu_vram_used_percent[3m]) > 92
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High sustained VRAM usage on GPU node"
```

carla: working on a Grafana panel that will show a stacked view of: gpu_vram_used_percent, gpu_vram_free_mb, gpu_temp_c, device_ecc_total (rate), and pod_oom_count — in 1m/5m/15m buckets. Will post link soon.

ops_bot: Note: changed autoscaler config to add 10% headroom to GPU pools in ap-southeast-1 to reduce immediate OOM risk.

leah: customer impact summary: brief region-level latency increase, 0.9% 5xx rate during peak. Affected workloads were low-latency endpoints using small batches. No user data lost.

sre_manager: handoff plan: @derek please take ownership for replacement ticket and the alert PR. Ensure we add a test to our synthetic suite that runs small-batch realtime requests ramp in ap-southeast-1.

derek: taking over. Ill create an internal ticket for RMA on node-gpu-07 and start the PR for alerts + dashboard. Assigning a 48h follow-up.

tom: suggestion for long-term: consider gating ECC pages to correlate with `gpu_utilization_percent < 10` to catch idle nodes that still show ECC noise. Noisy ECC on idle hardware is more likely hardware failure.

carla: added Grafana link: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd123/gpu-health?orgId=1 (panel: per-node-ecc-and-vram).

leah: I pushed the post-incident stub in the incident tracker with metrics and action items: - RMA node-gpu-07 (owner: derek) - Promote ECC alert to warning with sustained thresholds and escalate rules (owner: leah) - Dashboard panel + playbook (owner: carla) - Synthetic small-batch test (owner: tom)

sre_manager: good. Make sure to capture PromQL and exact rationale for the thresholds, and include the decision to add autoscaler headroom. We'll review in the postmortem meeting.

incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring. Handoff complete at ts 1815002800.

derek: quick follow-up note: I'll add an annotation to the alert PR describing the tradeoffs: reduce noise vs. risk of delayed detection. Will add a canary period where new rule runs as warning for 72h before promoting to page.

leah: thanks all. tagging this thread for postmortem review tomorrow.
